summary: Our educational game is designed to introduce young beginners to the real-world concepts of NASA mission planning, spacecraft designing, and launching. Unlike traditional educational games, it focuses on key aspects of space exploration, including orbital selection, spacecraft design, mission objectives, and resource management. Players are given the opportunity to plan their own space missions by selecting suitable spacecraft, determining mission requirements, and making important decisions within a limited budget. The game encourages critical thinking and problem-solving by challenging players to use their available resources efficiently while overcoming mission constraints. Through an interactive and engaging experience, players gain a basic understanding of how real-world space missions are planned, developed, and executed. By combining education with simulation and gameplay, our project aims to make complex aerospace concepts easier to understand and inspire young learners to explore the fields of space science, engineering, and technology.
details:
Our project is an educational space mission simulation game designed to introduce young beginners to the real-world processes involved in planning, designing, and launching NASA-style space missions. Players take on the role of mission planners, making important decisions at different stages of a mission. They can select mission types, define objectives, choose target celestial bodies, select suitable orbits, and design spacecraft according to their mission requirements. Players must also manage limited financial resources while making strategic decisions to ensure mission success.

The game provides an interactive learning experience that simplifies complex aerospace concepts and encourages critical thinking, problem-solving, decision-making, and resource management. Its intended impact is to make space exploration more accessible and engaging for young learners while inspiring interest in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM).

We developed the project using Unity and C#, incorporating Artificial Intelligence (AI) to support development and enhance the project. Unity provides the environment for building the interactive game, while C# handles the underlying game logic, mechanics, and user interactions.

The creative aspect of our project lies in combining space exploration with economic and strategic simulation. Rather than simply allowing players to launch a spacecraft, we challenge them to think like real mission planners by considering budgets, spacecraft requirements and mission constraints. Throughout development, our team considered educational value, realistic mission-planning concepts, accessibility for beginners, resource limitations, overall gameplay engagement and usage of NASA resources.
